_doc: Team Deathmatch (2v2, 3v3): unlimited lives. A knocked-out fighter comes back after respawn_seconds on its team's spawn pad (against its own side wall), invulnerable for spawn_protect_seconds or until it attacks. Every KO scores for the other team; first to score_to_win (indexed by fighters per side) wins, or the higher score when time runs out. A tie at time goes to sudden death: the next KO wins. Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds. Shrines ("shrines", over data/rules/shrines.json): one in the middle, haste then might, on the shared timings.
